text:
kai.design: quick eyeball on the compact preview frame I dropped — suppression and routing pills are still easy to confuse when skimming. frame: https://img.redwood.local/design/compact_preview_v4.png
rachel.pm: yeah, on narrow width the pills sit super tight. proposal: make 'Route' a filled pill + icon, and 'Suppress' an outlined pill with a left accent stripe so they read differently at a glance.
dante.eng: outlined pill is fine but use 2px stroke for small devices. also make pills individually focusable (tabindex=0) so keyboard users can reach them.
mira.sre: accessibility: avoid aria-live assertive. use role/status + aria-live=polite and debounce updates by 300ms so we don't spam screen readers during rapid edits.
henry.content: microcopy: shorten labels to "Route" / "Suppress" and tooltip copy to active voice: "Routes alerts to selected channels" / "Suppresses alerts for 2 hours". empty state: "No thresholds yet — create one to start alerting." CTA: "Add threshold".
kai.design: good. small UX ask: attach the suppression callout above the pill row (not floating) and make it collapsible (chevron) on mobile so it doesn't push action buttons offscreen.
dante.eng: will implement a stable preview_id in the merged-preview API so frontend can replace inner text without replacing the node (prevents VO losing context).
a11ybot: checklist: roving tabindex for pill group, non-color focus indicator, icons inside pills, role=status + aria-live=polite + 300ms debounce, stable preview_id, reduced-motion support.
mira.sre: I'll add keyboard/focus and aria debounce tests to QA.
kai.design: thanks all — I'll update the Figma frames and post a deuteranopia palette. tagging @dante.eng @mira.sre for follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
